Kay Kraft's tribute to Ekushey
2017-02-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/kay-krafts-tribute-ekushey-1360036

Kay Kraft has brought out a special line to pay homage to our pride that is Ekushey February. The designs, cuts, patterns and compositions featured have been made keeping the Ekushey theme in mind.  Colours that take precedence for this new collection include mourning black, the red of the sun, and the purity of white.  This new line-up includes saris, shalwar kameez sets, tops, shirts, skirts, panjabis, etc. There is also a children's wardrobe.

The wardrobe is also quite reasonably priced for the average consumer, and available at all their outlets.
